race.comment: TYRANT REX (8) was very disappointing on debut as the favourite at Kilmore, and had been making some throat noises during the running that day, which suggests that he may have been playing around with the bit. He will be better for the experience, and is worth another chance to make amends. Follow your money. OSTROM (4) needed her resuming run at Mornington, but still managed to hold onto third place. She strips fitter, and can win a race like this. CHARLEANOR (1) will be peaking third up from a spell, and a good draw gives her a good shot at a top 3 spot. Include. INNER THOUGHTS (3) strips fitter second up, and she can be a sharp improver in this field. Each way value. SOUTHERN SWAY (11) makes her debut from a tricky gate, but has looked promising at the jump-outs. Check the market support.
